SPECIAL LEAVE PETITION (CIVIL) Diary No. 12423/2022  (Arising out of impugned final judgment and order dated 30-01-2018  in FAFOD No. 560/2016 passed by the High Court of Judicature at  Allahabad)
 CHITRA KUMARI & ANR. Petitioner  VERSUS  ALI SHER & ORS. Respondent  (IA No.85369/2022-CONDONATION OF DELAY IN FILING and IA  No.85372/2022-EXEMPTION FROM FILING C/C OF THE IMPUGNED JUDGMENT  and IA No.85370/2022-EXEMPTION FROM FILING O.T.)
 Date : 18-05-2023

entities.text: High Court of Judicature at  Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: This petition was called on for hearing today.
HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE K.M. JOSEPH  HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE ARAVIND KUMAR  For Petitioner(s)

Dr. Sushil Balwada, AOR  Mr. Ajit Kumar Thakur, Adv.
 Mr. Sandiv Kalia, Adv.
 Mr. Ram Nath, Adv.
 Ms. Nirmala Saini, Adv.
 Ms. Sanjeeda Khurana, Adv.
 Mr. V G R Achary, Adv.
 For Respondent(s)
UPON hearing the counsel the Court made the following  O R D E R
This is a case where in a claim under Section 166 of the Motor Vehicles Act, 1988, Rs.1,89,428/- has been awarded by the Motor Accidents Claims Tribunal.
The appeal carried to the High Court was barred by delay of 6 years 196 days.
Reason: The High Court dismissed the application to condone the delay and consequently the appeal.

The present special leave petition is filed again with delay of Chitra Kumari vs Ali Sher on 18 May, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/155160508/
1 738 days.
Noticing the amount which has been awarded by the MACT, we are inclined to examine the matter.

However, we must make it clear that in case this Court enhances compensation, the petitioners will not be entitled to any interest on the enhanced compensation for the period of the delay in filing the matter before the High Court as also the delay occasioned in filing the special leave petition.
Issue notice in the special leave petition subject to the said condition.
Issue notice in the application for condonation of delay also.

(NIDHI AHUJA) (RENU KAPOOR)
